bagPolicy.summary: SAP Center allows bags up to 20” x 14” x 11” in size, with smaller bags recommended for quicker entry. All bags larger than 5” x 9” x 2” are subject to X-Ray inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are permitted regardless of size but will be X-Ray screened.

parking.note: There are over 3,000 parking spaces within a 1/3-mile radius of the SAP Center. Approximately 1,500 spaces are available on-site, with entry from Santa Clara Street or Julian Street. Prepaid parking is available for San Jose Shark Season ticket holders.

rideshare.note: After the event, use the rideshare pickup zones on Stockton Avenue, Cahill Street, or Almaden Boulevard. Check the official pickup map for exact spots. Nearby sections of Santa Clara Street and Barack Obama Boulevard close to vehicles for 20 to 30 minutes after events.

concessions.note: SAP Center introduces new food concepts and menu items for the 2019-20 season, featuring a mix of local brands and fan favorites. Highlights include Smoking Pig BBQ, Sushi Confidential, and unique offerings like Poke Tacos and Dole Whip.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible public payphones and courtesy house phones are available inside the South Entrance, near the exit doors at Section 110, and on the exterior of the building facing Autumn Street. For information on wheelchairs and mobility devices, please see the wheelchairs and mobility devices section below.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is normally prohibited. In an emergency, ask for assistance at the North or South Information Desk before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Ticket Office is open only on event days, two hours before the start of each event. The Ticket Office at SAP Center is located in the southeast corner of SAP Center at San Jose.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors open one hour before most events. Check the event page for the confirmed time. Sharks games use different entry schedules for members and non-members.
